data.long_description:
Own a piece of one of Dubai's most anticipated residential developments at Binghatti Hills 2. This beautifully designed studio apartment spanning 504.39 sq.ft. offers the perfect balance of style, comfort, and investment potential in the heart of Dubai Science Park.


  Inspired by the elegance of rolling hills, Binghatti Hills showcases iconic architecture, premium interiors, and world-class amenities that redefine modern urban living. The apartment features a bright open-plan layout, sophisticated finishes, floor-to-ceiling windows, and thoughtfully designed spaces that maximize both functionality and comfort.


  Whether you're a first-time buyer, seasoned investor, or looking for a future-ready home, this property presents an exceptional opportunity with strong rental demand and excellent growth prospects.

  • Elegant Contemporary Design
